subject.title: iOS/WebChat messages append to transcript but do not trigger/deliver assistant replies

question: Should #97983 wait for current-main native iOS/Gateway live proof before any new fix PR is queued?
rationale: The issue has strong released-build evidence, but current source has adjacent generic fixes and the remaining native app boundary is not isolated enough for a safe autonomous repair.

options.title: Require native iOS live proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open under maintainer ownership until a real iOS app send shows the exact missing step between WebSocket connection, `chat.send`, dispatch, run start, and reply display.

options.title: Scope as generic reply-init fallout
options.body: Treat the closed beta reply-session fix as sufficient only if maintainers can show the native app now reaches normal `chat.send` and reply delivery on current main or beta.

options.title: Move to restart-recovery tracker
options.body: Use #99346 as canonical only if a reproduction proves the native iOS symptom always requires the post-restart `agent:main:boot` takeover path.

recommendation.title: Require native iOS live proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open under maintainer ownership until a real iOS app send shows the exact missing step between WebSocket connection, `chat.send`, dispatch, run start, and reply display.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the current assignee and has adjacent WebChat delivery-history work in the relevant path.
